class.name: NetwService
class.brief_description: Opt-in base for a [Node] that registers itself as a session service on the [NetwMultiplayer] of its branch.
class.description:
Registration is bound to tree membership. The service enters the registry when the node enters the tree and leaves when it exits, skipping the editor, so it is discoverable through [method NetwMultiplayer.service_get] exactly while it is mounted under a live tree. The lifecycle is sealed: a subclass overrides [method _service_entered] and [method _service_exiting] rather than the tree notifications, so no forgotten [code]super[/code] call can silently drop registration. The lifecycle resolves the session through the branch [NetwMultiplayer], not through a [MultiplayerTree], so a service configures under a root install with no owning tree exactly as it does under a scoped tree. [codeblock] class_name MatchClock extends NetwService
func _service_type() -> Script: return MatchClock # register under a family base, optional
func _service_entered(api: NetwMultiplayer) -> void: api.session_entered.connect(_on_session_entered)
func _service_exiting(api: NetwMultiplayer) -> void: api.session_entered.disconnect(_on_session_entered) [/codeblock] A node that already extends a non-[Node] base cannot adopt this one under GDScript single inheritance. It calls [method register] and [method unregister] directly instead. A subclass written in C++ rather than GDScript overrides the [code]service_entered[/code] and [code]service_exiting[/code] C++ virtuals instead, and skips [method _service_type] entirely: a class with no script attached has no [Script] to return with, and [method NetwMultiplayer.service_register] keys it by its own class name. [LobbyDirectory] is the shipped example.

method.name: _service_entered
method.description: Called after the service registers, with the [param api] of its branch. Override for per-service setup such as signal wiring or clock binding. It does not run in the editor, when [method _should_register] returns [code]false[/code], or when the node resolves no session at all.

method.name: _service_exiting
method.description: Called before the service unregisters, with the [param api] of its branch. Override to tear down whatever [method _service_entered] set up. Mirrors the conditions of [method _service_entered].

method.name: _service_type
method.description: Override to return the registration key for this service. Return a family base type so [method NetwMultiplayer.service_get] and [method NetwMultiplayer.service_get_all] resolve its subclasses. Return [code]null[/code] to register the concrete script. Instances that share a key replace each other, so multi-instance families should keep concrete keys and use [method NetwMultiplayer.service_get_all].

method.name: _should_register
method.description: Override to return [code]false[/code] when this service should not register on entering the tree, for example under a test runner or behind a feature flag. A service that does not override this always registers. A transport service that needs peer-to-peer or a native client consults [method is_transport_restricted] here to stay dormant in a restricted environment.

method.name: get_transport_restricted_probe
method.description: Returns the probe [method set_transport_restricted_probe] installed, or an invalid [Callable] when none is.

method.name: is_transport_restricted
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the probe installed through [method set_transport_restricted_probe] reports that the environment forbids peer-to-peer and native transports. Returns [code]false[/code] when no probe is installed, which is the normal case.

method.name: register
method.description: Registers [param service] as a session service on the [NetwMultiplayer] of its branch, reached through [member Node.multiplayer]. When [param type] is [code]null[/code], the script class of [param service] is the registration key. This is the entry point for a node that cannot extend [NetwService], and it seals nothing: such a caller owns the matching [method unregister]. A branch whose API is a plain [SceneMultiplayer] is a silent no-op, so the node still works as an ordinary [Node] and features degrade rather than error. [codeblock] func _enter_tree() -> void: NetwService.register(self) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_transport_restricted_probe
method.description: Installs the [param probe] an embedding addon calls when the runtime environment allows only a WebSocket or HTTP relay, such as a Discord iframe that forbids WebRTC and native SDKs. The probe returns a [bool] and [method is_transport_restricted] is what reads it. Nothing installs one in a normal build, so nothing pays for it.

method.name: unregister
method.description: Unregisters [param service] from the [NetwMultiplayer] of its branch, under the same [param type] key [method register] used. [codeblock] func _exit_tree() -> void: NetwService.unregister(self) [/codeblock]
